pairs: cum immutavit vultum suum coram Achimelech,
when he changed his appearance in the sight of Abimelech,
I will bless the Lord at all times.
semper laus ejus in ore meo.
His praise will be ever in my mouth.
May the meek listen and rejoice.
et exaltemus nomen ejus in idipsum.
and let us extol his name in itself.
et ex omnibus tribulationibus meis eripuit me.
and he carried me away from all my tribulations.
and your faces will not be confounded.
et de omnibus tribulationibus ejus salvavit eum.
and he saved him from all his tribulations.
Immittet angelus Domini in circuitu timentium eum,
The Angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear him,
Gustate et videte quoniam suavis est Dominus;
Taste and see that the Lord is sweet.
beatus vir qui sperat in eo.
Blessed is the man who hopes in him.
quoniam non est inopia timentibus eum.
For there is no destitution for those who fear him.
inquirentes autem Dominum non minuentur omni bono.
but those who seek the Lord will not be deprived of any good thing.
I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
Quis est homo qui vult vitam;
Which is the man who wills life,
who chooses to see good days?
et labia tua ne loquantur dolum.
and your lips from speaking deceit.
The eyes of the Lord are on the just,
et aures ejus in preces eorum.
and his ears are with their prayers.
Vultus autem Domini super facientes mala,
But the countenance of the Lord is upon those who do evil,
ut perdat de terra memoriam eorum.
to perish the remembrance of them from the earth.
et ex omnibus tribulationibus eorum liberavit eos.
and he freed them from all their tribulations.
Juxta est Dominus iis qui tribulato sunt corde,
The Lord is near to those who are troubled in heart,
and he will save the humble in spirit.
Many are the afflictions of the just,
et de omnibus his liberabit eos Dominus.
but from them all the Lord will free them.
The Lord preserves all of their bones,
not one of them shall be broken.
The death of a sinner is very harmful,
and those who hate the just will fare badly.
The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants,
et non delinquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
and none of those who hope in him will fare badly.
